title: On the Inactive tab the bulk bar's X shows Clear selection and leaves the mode
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part at the test location, so the Inactive tab lists a row.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Activate parts.
  3. Hover over the X at the right end of the dark bar.
  4. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
  5. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮).
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The checkbox column and the dark bar appear.

Step 3:

  • A hover text reading "Clear selection" appears.

Step 4:

  • Bulk mode ends, and the checkbox column and the bar disappear.

Step 5:

  • The menu lists "Cycle count", "Activate parts" and "Export" again.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • S2-R9: “An X button sits at the right end of the bar. Hovering it shows "Clear selection", which is also its screen reader label.”
  • S2-R9a: “The X leaves the mode, clears the selection and puts the toolbar back to its normal state.”
